edges.reason: Constructor uses _msgSender() to assign the initial reflection supply and owner.
transfer passes msg.sender as the transfer source.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender for allowance spending.
manualswap requires msg.sender to equal _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend requires msg.sender to equal _feeAddrWallet1.
Cooldown enforcement compares stored cooldown against block.timestamp.
swapTokensForEth uses block.timestamp as the router deadline.
openTrading uses block.timestamp as the liquidity deadline.
_rTotal is derived from _tTotal via MAX modulo arithmetic.
_transferStandard debits and credits reflection balances in _rOwned.
_takeTeam adds the team reflection share to the contract _rOwned entry.
_reflectFee subtracts the reflection fee from _rTotal.
_reflectFee adds the token fee to _tFeeTotal.
_approve writes into the _allowances mapping.
allowance reads from the _allowances mapping.
_transfer checks _isExcludedFromFee to skip fee logic.
_transfer requires sender and recipient not to be flagged in bots.
_transfer reads and writes per-address cooldown timestamps.
_transfer compares addresses against uniswapV2Pair to detect buys/sells.
_transfer compares addresses against uniswapV2Router.
_transfer gates the automatic swap on swapEnabled.
_transfer checks the inSwap guard before swapping.
_transfer enforces the _maxTxAmount limit on buys.
_transfer sets the _feeAddr1 tax fee value.
_transfer sets the _feeAddr2 team fee value.
balanceOf reads the account reflection balance from _rOwned.
openTrading assigns the router instance to uniswapV2Router.
openTrading assigns the created pair to uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading sets the tradingOpen flag after liquidity is added.
openTrading enables swapEnabled.
openTrading enables cooldownEnabled.
openTrading lowers _maxTxAmount to the fixed cap.
setBots writes true into the bots mapping for owner-supplied addresses.
delBot clears the bots flag for the supplied address.
setCooldownEnabled toggles the cooldownEnabled flag.
sendETHToFee forwards half the ETH to _feeAddrWallet1.
sendETHToFee forwards half the ETH to _feeAddrWallet2.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal to compute the reflection supply.
_getCurrentSupply reads _tTotal to compute the token supply.
tokenFromReflection requires the amount to be below _rTotal.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to the zero address.
Constructor sets the initial owner via _msgSender.
Constructor mints the full reflection supply into _rOwned.
Constructor assigns _feeAddrWallet1.
Constructor assigns _feeAddrWallet2.
Constructor marks owner, contract and fee wallets as fee-excluded.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom reduces the allowance through _approve.
approve delegates allowance writing to _approve.
_transfer finalizes accounting by calling _tokenTransfer.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth before finishing its own state updates.
_transfer sends ETH to fee wallets inside the transfer path.
_tokenTransfer routes to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard obtains amounts from _getValues.
_transferStandard distributes the team share via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard applies fee reflection via _reflectFee.
_getValues computes token values through _getTValues.
_getValues computes reflection values through _getRValues.
_getValues obtains the current rate from _getRate.
_getRate derives supplies from _getCurrentSupply.
balanceOf converts the reflection balance using tokenFromReflection.
tokenFromReflection divides by the rate returned from _getRate.
openTrading approves router spending through _approve.
manualswap invokes the external swap through swapTokensForEth.
manualswap reads the contract balance via balanceOf.
manualsend forwards contract ETH via sendETHToFee.
swapTokensForEth makes the external router swap call.
sendETHToFee performs raw ETH transfers to fee wallets.
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH on the external router.
_reflectFee performs unchecked reflection supply arithmetic.
The external router swap can re-enter the transfer path through fallback/receive.
ETH transfers to fee wallets allow a receiving contract to re-enter _transfer.
The payable receive hook accepts ETH and can be used as a reentrancy entry point.
The caller-supplied amount flows into transfer.
The from argument flows into the internal _transfer logic.
The to argument flows into the internal _transfer logic.
The amount argument flows into the internal _transfer logic.
The cached contract token balance is passed to swapTokensForEth.
The cached contract ETH balance is forwarded to sendETHToFee.
The cached current rate produced by _getRate feeds reflection math.
The tokenAmount argument is passed to the router swap.
The bots_ array entries are written into the bots mapping.
The account argument indexes the _rOwned mapping in balanceOf.
The spender argument flows into _approve.
The onoff argument is written into cooldownEnabled.
The amount argument is split between the two fee wallets.
The rAmount argument is validated and divided by the rate.
The tAmount argument feeds the reflection value computation.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only flows through transfer into _transfer and can be merged with the transfer entry point.
The from parameter is consumed exclusively by the internal _transfer logic.
The to parameter is consumed exclusively by the internal _transfer logic.
The amount parameter of _transfer is bound to that function's accounting path.
contractTokenBalance is a temporary local computed and used within _transfer.
contractETHBalance is the amount passed directly to sendETHToFee.
currentRate is the direct return value of _getRate and can be merged with it.
tokenAmount is the sole input consumed by swapTokensForEth.
bots_ is iterated by setBots to populate the bots mapping.
account is only used to index _rOwned inside balanceOf.
spender is only forwarded from approve into _approve.
onoff is assigned directly to cooldownEnabled by setCooldownEnabled.
amount is the ETH value distributed by sendETHToFee.
rAmount is validated and converted inside tokenFromReflection.
tAmount is the input consumed by _transferStandard arithmetic.
